When a mixture of calcium hydroxide and ammonium chloride is heated, ammonia gas is made.
calcium hydroxide + ammonium chloride → calcium chloride + water + ammonia
Ammonia gas is soluble in water and toxic. Ammonia gas reacts with hot copper(II) oxide to make
nitrogen.
ammonia + copper(II) oxide → copper + water + nitrogen
A student makes nitrogen using the apparatus shown in Fig. 1.1.
